step1_analysis.description: Generates a bias voltage for a dead-zone amplifier based on a control voltage, compensating for threshold voltage variations to maintain a stable dead-zone.

paper_reference.title: A New TX Leakage-Suppression Technique for an RFID Receiver Using a Dead-Zone Amplifier

DC_Power.description: Total DC power consumption of the bias circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: With VCTRL=0.6V, each of the 3 active NMOS branches draws ~43uA. Total current ~130uA. Power = 130uA * 1.8V = 234uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact control voltage applied to the bottom NMOS transistors. Scaled for 1.8V SKY130 from the original 3.3V 0.18um process.

Output_Bias_Voltage.description: DC voltage at the output node N0

sky130_expected.calculation: For 130uA total current, the diode-connected PMOS load (W/L=20) requires Vsg ~ 0.93V. V(N0) = 1.8V - 0.93V = 0.87V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Varies with the control voltage and resulting branch currents. The paper reported 0.78V, which aligns closely with the expected ~0.87V in SKY130.

Control_Sensitivity.description: Change in output bias voltage per unit change in control voltage (dV_N0 / dV_CTRL)

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated by sweeping VCTRL from 0.6V to 0.8V and measuring the delta in V(N0).
sky130_expected.reasoning: As VCTRL increases, NMOS current increases, pulling N0 lower. The relationship is non-linear but expected to be negative.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC operating point and sweeps control voltage to observe output bias variation and sensitivity.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dead-Zone Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCTRL NCTRL 0 0.6

* Short control inputs to VCTRL
V1 NCTRL N7 0
V2 NCTRL N5 0
V3 NCTRL N4 0

* DUT
XM1 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N1 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N8 N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N0 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 N6 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N6 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N2 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
let v_out = v(N0)
print power
print v_out

* DC Sweep for Sensitivity
dc VCTRL 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc v_out_0_6 find v(N0) at=0.6
meas dc v_out_0_8 find v(N0) at=0.8
let sensitivity = (v_out_0_8 - v_out_0_6) / 0.2
print sensitivity

quit
.endc
